_comment: Model profiles for delegate.ps1. Always pinned: Cursor's default is 'auto' and both CLIs offer Claude models, so an unpinned worker could silently use Claude. Check model IDs with: agent --list-models / agy models

code.purpose: Well-specified implementation tasks that follow the lead's instructions. Cheap and fast.

code-hard.purpose: Implementation tasks needing more reasoning (tricky bugs, larger refactors), or a retry after a 'code' worker failed review twice.

council.purpose: Read-only deliberation: independent positions on a design or decision question. No file edits.
